title: Testing Bootstrap JavaScript Components
keywords: accessibility, performance, debugging, and professional practice
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of testing bootstrap javascript components and when it is appropriate.
Apply trigger behavior using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study testing bootstrap javascript components and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Testing Bootstrap JavaScript Components makes the interface more robust for real users and real content. Measure and reproduce behavior, inspect semantics and focus, and document the browser, viewport, steps, and result so another developer can repeat the check.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating testing bootstrap javascript components as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
